concept: A workforce built around local opportunity
brief: Three clear upright stylized human figures with rounded heads, arranged inside a wide open deep-green architectural employment frame. The central figure is terracotta, the two side figures are jade and warm ivory. A shared solid foundation connects their roles; one small stepped gold/green hiring tab joins the frame. The idea is a balanced professional workforce and local hiring opportunity, not abstract arrows or plants. Forest green #174F40, jade #4C8668, terracotta #BE7154 and warm ivory. No flags, racial markers, demographic percentages, arrows or written labels.
